tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Search the Cloud Logging entries of a Google Cloud project in a time range, newest first, with a Logging query language filter such as resource.type="k8s_container" AND severity>=ERROR. Returns each entry's time, severity, log, resource and message, cut when long, and a Logs Explorer link.

filter.description: The Logging query language filter, passed to Cloud Logging as given. The time range is added to it. Empty matches every entry.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

project.description: The project ID, for example shop-prod. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one project.

since.description: Only entries at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: one hour before until.

until.description: Only entries before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.description: Read Cloud Monitoring time series of a Google Cloud project with a monitoring filter such as metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.labels.service_name="checkout", optionally aligned and reduced. Returns each series' metric and resource labels and its points, newest first.

aligner.description: How each series is aligned. ALIGN_RATE suits counters; ALIGN_MEAN suits gauges. Default: none, or ALIGN_MEAN with alignmentPeriod.

alignmentPeriod.description: Align points to periods of this many seconds, at least 60. Default: raw points, or a period that gives about 120 points when aligner is set.

filter.description: The monitoring filter, passed to Cloud Monitoring as given. It must name one metric.type.

groupBy.description: Labels to keep when reducing, for example resource.labels.service_name.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

project.description: The project ID, for example shop-prod. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one project.

reducer.description: Combine series with this reducer, grouped by groupBy. Needs an aligner.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: one hour before until.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: query_promql
tools.description: Run a PromQL range query on the Cloud Monitoring metrics of a Google Cloud project, including Managed Service for Prometheus metrics. Returns each series' labels and its points, oldest first.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

project.description: The project ID, for example shop-prod. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one project.

query.description: The PromQL query, for example sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) by (service).

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: one hour before until.

step.description: Seconds between points, at least 10. Default: a step that gives about 120 points.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List the Cloud Monitoring alerts of a Google Cloud project that were open at some time in a range, newest first: state, open and close times, policy and severity, metric, resource and a console link.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

project.description: The project ID, for example shop-prod. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one project.

since.description: Only alerts open at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

state.description: Only alerts in this state. Default any.

until.description: Only alerts opened before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List what changed in a Google Cloud project in a time range, newest first, from its Admin Activity and System Event audit logs: deploys, config changes, GKE upgrades and the like. Returns each change's time, service, method, resource, who made it and whether it failed.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 500. Default 100.

project.description: The project ID, for example shop-prod. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one project.

resource.description: Only changes to resources whose name contains this text, for example services/checkout.

service.description: Only changes through this API, for example run.googleapis.com or container.googleapis.com.

since.description: Only changes at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

until.description: Only changes before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: get_gke_cluster
tools.description: Get a GKE cluster of a Google Cloud project: status, versions, conditions, node pools with their status and autoscaling, and its most recent operations such as upgrades. Without cluster, list the project's clusters with their status.

cluster.description: The cluster's name. Leave it out to list the clusters.

location.description: The cluster's region or zone, for example europe-west1. Required with cluster.

project.description: The project ID, for example shop-prod. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one project.

tools.name: list_service_health_events
tools.description: List the Google Cloud incidents that Personalized Service Health says affect a project, most recently updated first: title, state, products and locations, times and the latest update.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

project.description: The project ID, for example shop-prod. It may be left out when Sidekick reads only one project.

since.description: Only events updated at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: 24 hours before until.

state.description: Only events in this state. Default any.

until.description: Only events updated before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.
